text:
sam: Morning 1: saw a cluster spike: many GPU jobs failing after start in eu-west1. Nodes report free GPUs but high NIC egress.
anya: Are these mixed racks? ops-bot: alert 9488, node.egress_pct > 85% on eu-west1-rack-7
sam: Example: `eu-node-77`: GPUs=2 free, egress_mbps=690. We placed a 4-gang job, driver logs show NVLink retransmit, then kubelet evicted small sidecars -> big job preempted.
rod: Scheduler only checks GPU/CPU/mem. Network hotness isn't scored. This causes "ghost-free" GPUs that are actually unsuitable.
anya: Short fixes: cordon noisy nodes and drain non-gang streaming pods to net-heavy warmpool. We can also apply a transient taint: `egress-hot=true:NoSchedule` when egress>650.
sam: Medium fix: scheduler scoring plugin that penalizes nodes by egress_mbps for pods labeled `scheduling=egress-aware`. Rollout canary in eu-west1.
rod: I'll prototype the scoring tweak and add perf hooks: placement_time, eviction_count, egress_at_placement.
ops-bot: runbook link /runbooks/egress-gpu-collisions -> recommends cordon + QoS shaping + tainting.
anya: I'll own the cordon script and runbook update. Sam will track cost impact and tag incident.
sam: TL;DR: network egress contention + naive GPU binpacking = preemptions. Short-term cordon/taint, medium-term scheduler scoring + rack egress labels. Thanks.
